name: Slow Oscillation: Long Wavelength
description: Set the electron to oscillate slowly. Observe the wide spacing between wave crests -- this is the EM equivalent of a low-frequency radio wave (e.g. AM radio ~1 MHz carrier).

successCriteria.description: Observe widely spaced wave crests at low frequency

hints.message: Slow oscillation = long wavelength. This is like an AM radio carrier wave.
Notice how the electron (blue dot) moves up and down slowly on the antenna.
